role_1_training_targets.cost_per_solve: O(n^3) time, O(n^2) memory with n = minibatch size
role_1_training_targets.note: This is the minibatch W2 that the requirement names. It is a 2,000-of-100,000 approximation to the global OT it stands in for.

role_2_deployment.note: The trained corrector is a feed-forward map; no matching happens at inference. What is saved is the *global* OT between full clouds, not OT as a concept.

role_3_evaluation.note: Borne by the experimenter, not by a model user. Reported because 'OT-free' would otherwise overstate the case: the metric itself is an OT solve.

summary.statement: OT appears in two of three roles. Deployment is genuinely OT-free; training and evaluation are not.
